This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Suppoon" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species was distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin, with white circular marks on their thighs, as well as perpetually nearly-closed [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], lack of visible [[Nose/Legends|noses]], and a pair of thin [[Antenna/Legends|antennae]] extending up from the top of their heads and through their [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Suppoon" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], at least two members of this species served as entertainment for [[Gaar (title)|Gaar]] [[Suppoon]] within his [[Suppoon's palace|palace]].<ref name="Suppoon" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[1995]] comic book ''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Gaar Suppoon Hit]]'', written by [[Jim Woodring]] and illustrated by [[Art Wetherell]].<ref name="Marvel Release">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54269/star_wars_jabba_the_hutt_-_the_gaar_suppoon_hit_1995_1|text=Star Wars: Jabba The Hutt - The Gaar Suppoon Hit (1995) #1}}</ref>
